filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections are from top-tier educational channels like Neso Academy, Gate Smashers, and KnowledgeGATE, all with very high view counts. The Arabic selections are also from popular, well-regarded channels. One topic, 'Sets of Strings and Kleene Closure', had no suitable Arabic candidates as all shortlisted videos failed hard gates for low views, short duration, or incorrect language.
